# Ongoing - Global

Source: [4825](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4825); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-4825-n1"></a>

- Ongoing Global is rising-edge triggered: conditions remaining true do not retrigger; at least one must become false to rearm.

<a id="wiki-4825-n2"></a>

- Conditions check every server tick; without conditions it fires immediately at server start.
